K01 / Water↗

கிராம நீர் பாதுகாப்பு

Reliable village water

Ramanathapuram; southern Tamil Nadu screening areas

Evidence Groundwater resource and quality assessments are distinct evidence streams [S11]. Regional evidence cannot establish a particular village’s unmet need.

Response to assess Assess demand, leakage, storage and source quality first; compare repairs, safe rainwater capture and hydrogeologically suitable recharge. Reject recharge where contamination or saline conditions make it unsafe.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Seasonal supply days, source tests, household collection time, extraction and recharge context.
Outcomes to measure
Reliable supply days; tested water quality; collection time; operating cost.
Accountable roles to appoint
Panchayat or utility with an explicitly appointed maintenance operator.
Unresolved local evidence
Exact village, household baseline, aquifer suitability and lifecycle budget unverified.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

S11 · CGWB

Tamil Nadu

K02 / Water↗

நிலத்தடி நீர்

Groundwater depletion in hard-rock catchments

Interior Karnataka; Telangana plateau; Rayalaseema

Evidence CGWB’s Karnataka assessment provides resource screening [S10]; Telangana’s state plan supplies sector context [S07]. Neither is a well-yield guarantee.

Response to assess Build a community water budget; meter large abstractions; align crops with dependable supply; assess managed recharge with a hydrogeologist and downstream users.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Seasonal water levels, abstraction, well failures and water quality.
Outcomes to measure
Water-level trend over comparable seasons; extraction; irrigation water per unit output.
Accountable roles to appoint
Groundwater department, panchayat and participating water users.
Unresolved local evidence
Assessment-unit tables and present village surveys still needed.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

S10 · CGWB / Ground Water Directorate, KarnatakaS07 · MoEFCC NAPCC dashboard / EPTRI

Karnataka · Telangana · Andhra Pradesh

K03 / Water↗

ஏரிகள் மற்றும் கழிவுநீர்

Urban lakes and sewage inflows

Bengaluru lake catchments; Jakkur as a documented case

Evidence Jakkur’s practitioner account describes treated and untreated inflows, vegetation work and multiple maintenance institutions [S20].

Response to assess Trace every inlet; intercept pollution; verify treatment compliance; evaluate wetlands as polishing stages with ongoing maintenance, rather than substitutes for sewage treatment.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Inlet flows and pollutant loads; seasonal lake chemistry; treatment uptime.
Outcomes to measure
Compliant inflows; oxygen and nutrient trends; recurring maintenance completed.
Accountable roles to appoint
Utility, lake custodian and contracted operator, with community oversight.
Unresolved local evidence
2018 case observations are not current lake measurements or a causal impact trial.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

S20 · Biome Environmental TrustS19 · CPCB

Karnataka

K04 / Floods↗

வெள்ளத் தாங்குதிறன்

Flood pathways and wetland storage

Chennai basin; Hyderabad; Bengaluru; Puducherry urban catchments

Evidence Flood studies require rainfall, drainage, land-use and exposure evidence together. The Chennai event summary cautions against treating flood damage as rainfall attribution [S15].

Response to assess Map drainage and flood storage at catchment scale; protect water pathways; assess retention areas, maintenance and accessible evacuation routes. Check whether interventions shift flooding downstream.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Drain connectivity, observed inundation depth and duration, vulnerable assets and rainfall.
Outcomes to measure
Inundation duration under comparable storms; protected routes; warning reach.
Accountable roles to appoint
Urban local body, drainage authority and disaster-management teams.
Unresolved local evidence
Hydraulic modelling and local consent needed before earthworks.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

S15 · van Oldenborgh et al.; BAMS / WWAS16 · National Institute of Disaster ManagementS08 · MoEFCC NAPCC dashboard / DSTE

Tamil Nadu · Telangana · Karnataka · Puducherry

K05 / Floods↗

மலைச்சரிவு அபாயம்

Landslide exposure in the Western Ghats

Wayanad; Nilgiris; Kodagu as separate screening landscapes

Evidence The 2024 Wayanad assessment found intensified triggering rain with substantial modelling uncertainty [S14]. It does not establish the cause of every slope failure.

Response to assess Use official susceptibility maps, geotechnical inspection and local rainfall thresholds; prioritise evacuation access and exposure reduction. Retaining structures need engineered designs.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Slope geology, past failures, drainage, rainfall and households in runout paths.
Outcomes to measure
Warning-to-action time; evacuation drills; people and assets removed from high exposure.
Accountable roles to appoint
District disaster authority, qualified geotechnical team and local government.
Unresolved local evidence
Transfer from Wayanad to other slopes requires independent validation.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

S14 · World Weather Attribution

Kerala · Tamil Nadu · Karnataka

K06 / Heat↗

வெப்பத்திலிருந்து பாதுகாப்பு

Hot classrooms and public buildings

Tiruchirappalli concept; hot urban and peri-urban institutions

Evidence Telangana’s cool-roof policy defines material-performance provisions [S09]; it is policy evidence, not measured results for a particular school.

Response to assess Compare reflective roofs, external shade, safe ventilation and efficient cooling. Inspect waterproofing, structure, glare, maintenance and indoor air quality before retrofit.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Paired indoor/outdoor temperature and humidity logs; occupancy; roof condition; electricity.
Outcomes to measure
Occupied hours above an agreed comfort threshold; comparable indoor temperature; kWh.
Accountable roles to appoint
Building owner with facilities operator and qualified designer.
Unresolved local evidence
Building selection, hot-weather comparison and costed specifications pending.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

K07 / Heat↗

வெளிப்புறப் பணியாளர் வெப்ப அபாயம்

Outdoor workers and unequal heat exposure

Construction sites, markets, farms and transport hubs

Evidence State climate plans address health and livelihoods [S06, S07]. Air temperature alone does not capture all occupational exposure.

Response to assess Have occupational-health professionals design shade, rest, safe drinking-water access and warning procedures. Adapt work schedules with workers, protect wages and provide an emergency response protocol.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Task and exposure mapping; humidity and radiant heat; access to shade and water.
Outcomes to measure
Protected work periods; warning coverage; recorded heat incidents with reporting quality checked.
Accountable roles to appoint
Employer and local authority with worker representatives and health teams.
Unresolved local evidence
No medical threshold or clinical advice is inferred from this bank.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

S06 · MoEFCC NAPCC dashboardS07 · MoEFCC NAPCC dashboard / EPTRI

K08 / Coasts↗

கடலோர அரிப்பு

Shoreline erosion and coastal livelihoods

Coromandel and Malabar coasts; Puducherry and Karaikal

Evidence NCCR’s official summary reports shoreline change from both human and natural drivers [S17]. Historic erosion rates do not forecast an individual property’s future.

Response to assess Commission sediment-cell and hazard assessment; compare setbacks, dune recovery, relocation support and engineered protection. Evaluate neighbouring-shore impacts and fishing access.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Shoreline positions, seasonal beach profiles, structures, access and land tenure.
Outcomes to measure
Beach-profile trend; maintained livelihood access; exposure avoided.
Accountable roles to appoint
Coastal authority and local government with fishing communities.
Unresolved local evidence
Permits, sediment budget and long-term maintenance must be resolved.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

புயல் மற்றும் கடல் சீற்றம்

Cyclones, surge and delta settlements

Krishna and Godavari deltas; coastal Tamil Nadu; Yanam and Karaikal

Evidence State profiles identify differing cyclone, surge and river settings [S06, S08]. Hazard combinations vary by location.

Response to assess Map compound river–rain–surge exposure; strengthen last-mile warning, inclusive shelters and resilient essential services. Validate any ecosystem buffer against local habitat and hydrology.

Baseline to collect
Elevation, evacuation travel time, warning reach, essential-service exposure.
Outcomes to measure
Accessible shelter coverage; drill completion; service restoration time.
Accountable roles to appoint
District disaster authority, local government and utility owners.
Unresolved local evidence
Current official hazard maps and facility audits needed.

K10 / Coasts↗

பவளப்பாறை பாதுகாப்பு

Reefs and marine heatwaves

Lakshadweep; Gulf of Mannar for separate monitoring

Evidence The official 2024 response records Lakshadweep bleaching and INCOIS monitoring services [S24, S25]. This is not a current Gulf of Mannar condition report.

Response to assess Use dated bleaching alerts and ecological surveys; reduce local sewage, anchor and extraction damage; agree community-led response. Restoration cannot remove ocean warming.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Reef-cover transects, temperature stress, local pressures and fishing dependence.
Outcomes to measure
Live coral and recruitment trends; reduced damaging activity; livelihood resilience.
Accountable roles to appoint
Relevant reef and fisheries authorities with island or coastal communities.
Unresolved local evidence
Reef-specific condition and recovery evidence needed before restoration claims.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

K11 / Farming↗

மானாவாரி விவசாயம்

Dryland crops under erratic rainfall

Historical Anantapur region; interior dryland farming belts

Evidence ICAR’s vulnerability atlas and NICRA catalogue support agricultural screening and technology selection [S12, S13]; local effect sizes are not extracted here.

Response to assess Co-design crop calendars, locally suited varieties, soil-moisture conservation and diversified cropping with KVK agronomists. Test small plots before wider adoption.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Crop-wise yields, dry spells, soil moisture, input costs and labour.
Outcomes to measure
Yield stability across seasons; net margin; crop-failure frequency.
Accountable roles to appoint
Farmer group or FPO with KVK and agreed field support.
Unresolved local evidence
Current district boundaries, farmer cluster and two-season evaluation design needed.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

S12 · ICAR-CRIDAS13 · ICAR-CRIDA / NICRA

Andhra Pradesh · Karnataka · Telangana · Tamil Nadu

K12 / Farming↗

இயற்கை விவசாய மதிப்பீடு

Natural farming: test benefits and trade-offs

Crop-specific farmer trials in Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka

Evidence ICAR’s survey and sample study reports differing experiences between crops and states [S21]. Farmer perception and adopter comparisons do not establish universal causal benefits.

Response to assess Use comparable plots and whole-farm records to evaluate input reduction, nutrient balance, pest management and transition labour. Preserve farmer choice and avoid guaranteed yield or income claims.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Crop and soil comparability; prior yield; purchased and household inputs; labour.
Outcomes to measure
Net return including labour; yield variability; soil indicators; adoption retention.
Accountable roles to appoint
Participating farmers, independent agronomist and evaluation team.
Unresolved local evidence
Selection bias, market premiums and long-term nutrient balance need explicit treatment.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

S21 · ICAR-NAARM / ICAR-CRIDA for NITI Aayog

Andhra Pradesh · Karnataka

K13 / Farming↗

நீர்ப்பிடிப்பு மேலாண்மை

Farm ponds and watershed interventions

Semi-arid catchments; location selected after hydrology

Evidence ICAR-CRIDA lists farm-pond design guidance [S13]. A catalogue listing does not prove a pond is suitable or beneficial at every farm.

Response to assess Assess catchment water balance, soils, safety, evaporation and downstream rights; compare in-situ conservation with storage and supplemental irrigation.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Runoff, seasonal demand, soils, evaporation and downstream users.
Outcomes to measure
Supplemental water delivered; crop benefit; maintenance; downstream effects.
Accountable roles to appoint
Farmer group and watershed institution with engineering support.
Unresolved local evidence
No storage volume or construction budget should be set before survey.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

K14 / Land↗

நிலச் சீரழிவு

Land degradation and soil loss

Erosion-prone slopes and degraded cultivated catchments

Evidence SAC–ISRO provides land-degradation mapping and change-analysis resources [S18]. Remote-sensing categories need ground verification.

Response to assess Identify the degradation process first; assess contour measures, ground cover and appropriate grazing or cultivation changes. Protect drainage and land-user rights.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Erosion features, soil depth, cover, infiltration and land-use history.
Outcomes to measure
Ground cover; soil loss proxy; infiltration; productive use maintained.
Accountable roles to appoint
Land users and watershed authority with soil-conservation specialists.
Unresolved local evidence
Field diagnosis needed; a degraded-land label is not permission for plantation.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

K15 / Biodiversity↗

உள்ளூர் உயிரினங்கள் பாதுகாப்பு

Native habitats and invasive plants

Nilgiris and other Western Ghats landscapes

Evidence ATREE documents landscape-specific restoration and invasive-species research [S22]. Intervention success depends on habitat, disturbance and follow-up.

Response to assess Map native habitat and invasion; pilot species-appropriate removal with native recovery, erosion control and repeat monitoring. Budget follow-up before scaling.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Native species, invasive cover, regeneration and community resource use.
Outcomes to measure
Native recovery; invasive rebound; habitat function and livelihood effects.
Accountable roles to appoint
Forest or habitat custodian, restoration ecologist and rights-holding communities.
Unresolved local evidence
Removal-only campaigns and sapling counts cannot establish restoration success.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

K18 / Waste↗

கழிவு மற்றும் மீத்தேன்

Organic waste, dumpsites and methane

Municipalities, markets and institutional campuses

Evidence CPCB’s 2021–22 report records state processing and dumpsite information [S26]. Reported facilities do not demonstrate today’s processing quality.

Response to assess Audit composition and actual material flows; segregate at source; compare composting, digestion and safe residual disposal. Include worker safety, leachate, odour and product off-take.

Baseline to collect
Weighed waste streams, contamination, disposal routes and operating costs.
Outcomes to measure
Verified diversion; contamination; processing uptime; methane leakage where relevant.
Accountable roles to appoint
Local body and operator with waste-worker participation.
Unresolved local evidence
Avoid counting collected tonnage as treated tonnage or unverified carbon savings.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

Every proposed district, village or institutional project

K22 / Governance↗

சரியான அளவில் ஆதாரம்

Choose evidence at the right scale

Regional assessment → district screening → site design

Evidence MoES synthesises observed and projected regional climate [S01]. Scenario outputs, weather forecasts and measured local conditions answer different questions.

Response to assess Keep observation periods, scenarios, model resolution and uncertainty visible. Use multiple relevant datasets and technical review; investigate disagreements rather than averaging incompatible risk indices.

Baseline, measures & responsibilities
Baseline to collect
Source year, geography, methods, scenario and data quality.
Outcomes to measure
Traceable claims; reproducible baselines; documented uncertainty and correction history.
Accountable roles to appoint
Knowledge editor and relevant subject specialist.
Unresolved local evidence
This edition screens selected sources and does not claim an exhaustive systematic review.

Proposed application · owners are role suggestions, not confirmed partners. Agree timeline and lifecycle cost after site survey and design.

S01 · MoES / IITM; Krishnan et al. (editors)

Tamil Nadu · Kerala · Karnataka · Andhra Pradesh · Telangana · Puducherry · Lakshadweep

EVIDENCE → LOCAL DESIGN → VERIFIED OUTCOMES

Good research is a starting point.
A local baseline makes it actionable.

Before funding any demonstrator, record all seven readiness fields. None of the response options above establishes a funded project, confirmed partner or measured POIGAI result.

  1. Exact location
  2. Dated baseline
  3. Unmet local need
  4. Implementation partner
  5. Maintenance owner
  6. Costed design
  7. Measurable outcome

Resources & timeline

Price survey, design, permissions, capital works, operations, maintenance, monitoring and eventual replacement. Assign named owners who accept responsibility. Set dates after access, seasonal measurement needs and resources are agreed. This bank does not invent project budgets or delivery dates.

Protect the people and the place

Review land and water rights, community consent, accessibility, ecological effects and downstream impacts. Agree a comparison method before implementation; report failures and unintended effects alongside benefits.

METHOD & OPEN QUESTIONS

What this edition covers.

Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Puducherry and Lakshadweep. Neighbouring Western Ghats research is background only.

Curated evidence map, not an exhaustive review of all studies. Searches used government and original research organisations, research-team summaries and practitioner records. Review depth is stated per source. Search snippets and catalogues are explicitly distinguished from report excerpts. No full-text appraisal is claimed where access failed.

How sources were selected

Searches on 15 October 2026 covered state climate plans; regional climate and vulnerability; groundwater; floods and landslides; coasts and reefs; agriculture; restoration; sewage and waste; and energy and transport. Government agencies and original research teams were prioritised. Duplicate search results and general news were excluded as evidence records.

Only accessible excerpts and summaries were screened. This is not a full-text critical appraisal or systematic review; source counts refer to indexed resources, including portals and catalogues, rather than 30 completed study appraisals.

Where evidence is still thin

District-level cost-effectiveness, long-term maintenance, disaggregated impacts on vulnerable groups, salinity and mangrove restoration, fisheries adaptation, air pollution, industrial decarbonisation, fire, urban biodiversity and Eastern Ghats ecology need deeper study. Lakshadweep coverage currently focuses on reefs and heat stress.

Expand using district plans, university repositories, local-language studies and measured project evaluations. Record title, author, date, geography, method, findings, limitations and a stable URL; check for newer versions and corrections before adoption.

What is research, and what is POIGAI synthesis?

“Evidence” statements summarise the cited resource within its review depth. “Response to assess”, baseline, measures and accountable roles are POIGAI planning synthesis, not quoted study recommendations, proven packages or partner appointments. National and global findings are labelled and require local validation. Historical data are not presented as current conditions.

Corrections and contributions: send a public source URL, relevant place, method and any limitation to contact@poigai.com. Submissions require editorial verification before inclusion. This edition is manually maintained; no automatic refresh is implied.
